python3 -B - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, random, string, time
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('g','/workspace/submission/gateway.py');g=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(g)
rng=random.Random(4312)
userchars=string.ascii_letters+string.digits+"-_.!~*'()+"
tokenchars=string.ascii_letters+string.digits+"-.!%*_+`'~"
def quoted(s):
    return '"'+''.join(('\\'+c) if (c in '"\\' or rng.randrange(3)==0) else c for c in s)+'"'
start=time.monotonic()
for i in range(4000):
    user=''.join(rng.choice(userchars) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1,100)))
    encoded=''.join(('%%%02X'%ord(c)) if rng.randrange(2) else c for c in user)
    labels=[]
    for _ in range(rng.randrange(1,5)):
        label=rng.choice(string.ascii_letters+string.digits)
        if rng.randrange(2):
            label+=''.join(rng.choice(string.ascii_letters+string.digits+'-') for _ in range(rng.randrange(0,30)))
            label+=rng.choice(string.ascii_letters+string.digits)
        labels.append(label)
    host='.'.join(labels)
    norm='sip:'+user+'@'+host.lower()
    u='sIp:'+encoded+'@'+host+('.' if rng.randrange(2) else '')
    display=quoted(''.join(rng.choice(string.printable[:95]+'\t') for _ in range(rng.randrange(50))))
    tag=''.join(rng.choice(tokenchars) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1,129)))
    addr=display+rng.choice(['',' ','\t'])+'< \t'+u+'\t> \t; TaG \t=\t'+tag
    raw='MESSAGE '+u+' SIP/2.0\r\nf \t: '+addr+'\r\nt: <tel:+1>\r\ni: X\r\nCSeq: 0001\t MESSAGE\r\nP-Asserted-Identity: '+display+'<'+u+'>, '+quoted(' ", <>;')+'<TEL:+1>\r\nl: 0\r\n\r\n'
    parsed=g.parse_request(raw)
    assert parsed['from']==parsed['target']==parsed['pai'][0]==norm
    assert parsed['from_tag']==tag and parsed['pai'][1]=='tel:+1'
    wire=g.forward(parsed,norm,True)
    again=g.parse_request(wire)
    assert g.forward(again,norm,True)==wire
    for _ in range(3):
        x=rng.randrange(len(raw)+1)
        mutated=raw[:x]+rng.choice(['\n','\r','\x00','\x7f','\u00e9','"','\\',',',';','<','>','@','%',' ','\t'])+raw[x:]
        try:g.parse_request(mutated)
        except g.InvalidRequest:pass
print('4000 normalization round trips and 12000 parser mutations passed in %.2fs' % (time.monotonic()-start))
PY
